request_protocol: Exact same six V8 inputs and deterministic singleton/window plans; no outcome or timing filtering. 2,028 unique case/query plans are reused, not new workloads.
matched_assurance_panel: checked_certificate versus boolean_certificate: both construct a complete core diagnostic certificate, perform JSON roundtrip and independent full verification once per batch. Boolean route additionally freezes/merges/indexes unequal cells; both answer existence plus rational witness.
workflow_cost_panel: Four implementations answer the same Boolean question but do not have equal assurance obligations. Direct masks and incremental Z3 do not produce or independently verify a complete certificate. These are request-cost comparisons, not matched-assurance verification rankings.
timing: One warmup per case/type/method, 5 fresh setups per batch/method, seeded randomized method order. Setup/query/total retained separately; no tracemalloc. Same executed interpolation outputs outside all timers. No result memoization; requests within a batch differ. Imports, disk I/O and human work excluded.
scope: API cost isolation on existing controlled fixtures. No new algorithmic primitive, independent developer/production requirement evidence, defect count or universal speed claim.
